description: Meeting workflow transitions: submit, approve, reject, publish, cancel and organizer transfer with guards.

cases.inputs: Meeting status: Draft; actor: organizer; command: SubmitForApproval with AssignedApproverId of an eligible approver.
cases.log: Saved: status WaitingApproval; history row SubmitForApproval with the approver; notification "Cuộc họp cần được duyệt" to the approver.
preconditions: Meeting is Draft; organizer holds MeetingCreator.
Persisted meeting information passes the submission readiness check.
Approver is active, holds MeetingApprover and differs from the organizer.

cases.inputs: command: SubmitForApproval without an approver id.
actor: organizer; command: SubmitForApproval with a valid approver.
preconditions: Draft meeting with an empty stored title.
cases.return: Failure SubmissionNotReady with errors { title }; MSG81; status stays Draft.

preconditions: Actor is a Chair, not the creator.

cases.inputs: Meeting status: WaitingApproval; actor: assigned approver; command: Approve.
cases.log: Saved: status Approved; history row Approve; organizer notified "Cuộc họp đã được duyệt".
preconditions: Meeting is WaitingApproval with the actor as assigned approver.
Actor holds MeetingApprover and is not the organizer.

cases.log: Saved: status Published; history row Publish; "Cuộc họp đã được công bố" notification for the Chair, Secretary and Members but not the organizer; invitation emails staged for every active participant.
preconditions: Meeting is Approved; organizer holds MeetingCreator.
Roster has exactly one active Chair, one active Secretary and two Members.

cases.inputs: command: Cancel with reason "  Hoãn do bão  ".
cases.log: Saved: status Cancelled with CancelledAt, CancelledById, reason and CancelledFromStatus Published; history row Cancel with the reason; vote drafts deleted in the same transaction (ADR-0067); invitees (and guests) are notified with the reason by the staged cancellation messages.
preconditions: Meeting is Published; organizer holds MeetingCreator.
cases.return: Success(Cancelled); MSG261; reason trimmed to "Hoãn do bão".

precondition: Meeting in the required start status with a valid roster; actor with the required capability.
